statement: Let S_0 = 10, S_1 = 19, S_2 = 27, S_3 = 34, S_4 = 40, S_5 = 45, S_6 = 49, and S_7 = 52. Let t be the least integer with 0 <= t <= 7 such that S_t > n. The function returns a result r and does not fail, and r = true if and only if t is odd. Equivalently, r = true exactly when n lies in one of the inclusive integer intervals [10,18], [27,33], [40,44], or [49,50], and r = false exactly when n lies in [1,9], [19,26], [34,39], or [45,48].
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 50, where n is the integer value of the Std.I64 parameter.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, overflow, or panic.
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 50, where n is the integer value of the Std.I64 parameter.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true then there exists an odd integer t with 0 <= t <= 7 such that S_t > n and S_i <= n for every integer i with 0 <= i < t, where S_0 = 10, S_1 = 19, S_2 = 27, S_3 = 34, S_4 = 40, S_5 = 45, S_6 = 49, and S_7 = 52. Equivalently, the first required removal that exceeds the remaining stones occurs on Bob's turn.
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 50, where n is the integer value of the Std.I64 parameter.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = false then there exists an even integer t with 0 <= t <= 6 such that S_t > n and S_i <= n for every integer i with 0 <= i < t, where S_0 = 10, S_1 = 19, S_2 = 27, S_3 = 34, S_4 = 40, S_5 = 45, and S_6 = 49. Equivalently, the first required removal that exceeds the remaining stones occurs on Alice's turn.
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 50, where n is the integer value of the Std.I64 parameter.
